Statement 175, test = differ(value('b'),b) stars, is the one statement where SCRIP prints an error-detected line and sbl -bf does not: SCRIP defines VALUE (core_fn_table.inc) and answers it, while SPITBOL has no VALUE, so sbl -bf ends the call with ERROR 022, undefined function called, which SETEXIT traps.
